title: Banff Mountain Lakeside - E-bike Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for those who are not confident riding a bicycle.
Participants must be 12-years of age or older
policies: Ample free customer parking is available at the Banff Train Station
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This half-day tour showcases some of the most breathtaking landscapes in the Canadian Rockies and circles the Minnewanka Loop, renowned for its spectacular natural beauty and abundant wildlife. Your adventure begins with a visit to the historic ruins of Bankhead, an old mining town in the Cascade Valley. From there, the tour continues to Lake Minnewanka, the largest lake in Banff National Park, where the clear waters reflect the towering mountains above. 
Next, you'll visit Two Jack Lake; keep your camera ready, as the area is a wildlife haven. Frequent sightings include bears, bighorn sheep, and elk wandering through the forest. This tour not only offers a chance to witness the beauty of the Rockies but also provides an intimate look at the region's rich history and thriving wildlife.
